what_to_detect: A resolution exchanging the contents of two zones: zone_change events moving one player's cards from zone X to zone Y and from Y to X, or in one direction only where a zone was empty.
near_miss: A zone-exchange resolution that moves no card.
record_fields: acting line script text (Forge scripts a zone exchange as paired ChangeZoneAll clauses, as ExchangeZone, or through the Aura swap keyword, so no single api selects it)
